north.title: Ha Tinh and northward
north.body: Jobs are dispatched by area: the system picks the nearest technician with the right skills for the appliance.

central.title: Quang Tri to Quang Ngai
central.body: Technicians sign off each job with photos in the app, and every job has a step-by-step status.
central.bodyConfirm: Appointments are confirmed with the customer within {confirm}. Technicians sign off each job with photos in the app.

south.title: Gia Lai and southward
south.body: Every job has a step-by-step status and is reconciled with the brand or platform job by job.

network.title: One dispatch system for the whole country
network.body: Wherever the job is, it follows the same process: intake, scheduling, dispatch, sign-off and reconciliation.
